question.problem:
Several households were asked the number of children that lived there. The number of children in each was recorded below. If $X$ is the number of children that live at a randomly selected household, what is the expected value of $X?$

| Number of Children | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Number of Households | $6$ | $9$ | $6$ | $3$ |
question.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

We're given the frequencies of the number of childen, so we can start by computing the corresponding probabilities. The total number of households is $3+9+6+6=24,$ so the corresponding probabilities are as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=1)=f(1) & =\frac{6}{24}=\frac{1}{4} \\ P(X=2)=f(2) & =\frac{9}{24}=\frac{3}{8} \\ P(X=3)=f(3) & =\frac{6}{24}=\frac{1}{4} \\ P(X=4)=f(4) & =\frac{3}{24}=\frac{1}{8}\end{aligned}
$$

We organize these results in the table below.

| $x$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{3}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ |

Now, summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3)+4\cdot f(4) \\  & =1(\frac{1}{4})+2(\frac{3}{8})+3(\frac{1}{4})+4(\frac{1}{8}) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}+\frac{3}{4}+\frac{3}{4}+\frac{2}{4} \\  & =\frac{1+3+3+2}{4} \\  & =\frac{9}{4} \\  & =2.25.\end{aligned}
$$
